approved: Tax and Superannuation Laws Amendment (Increased Concessional Contributions Cap and Other Measures) Bill 2013

Supported the superannuation bills, saying the $35,000 concessional cap will benefit 171,000 Australians over 60 from July and 363,000 aged over 50 from July 2014, and that the low-income superannuation contribution of up to $500 will help 3.6 million Australians earning under $37,000, including 2.1 million women.

Criticised Labor's superannuation record, citing $192 billion in accumulated debt and a mining tax that collected only $200 million against a promised $3 billion, and detailed a 36 per cent increase in the self-managed super fund regulatory levy expected to raise $320 million over four years and affect more than 480,000 funds.
Tax and Superannuation Laws Amendment (Increased Concessional Contributions Cap and Other Measures) Act 2013
